The models that can take a document as input are **`mistral-large-2407`** and **`mistral-large-2402`**.

To pass a document, include it in the `content` array of a user message as an object with:
- `type: "document"`
- `document`: base64-encoded document content
- `mime_type`: the document's MIME type (e.g., `"application/pdf"`)

Example:
```json
{
  "role": "user",
  "content": [
    {"type": "text", "text": "Summarize this document"},
    {"type": "document", "document": "<base64-encoded-data>", "mime_type": "application/pdf"}
  ]
}
```

[Model capabilities](https://docs.mistral.ai/platform/models#model-capabilities)
[Multimodal messages](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/chat#multimodal-messages)
